item.title: Former Overwatch Lead claims he was given a horrid ultimatum: meet revenue goals or 1,000 developers would lose jobs
item.description: Former Overwatch lead Jeff Kaplan has claimed that, due to financial pressures brought on by the Overwatch League, he was given an ultimatum by then Blizzard CFO, Dennis Durkin. That ultimatum was, essentially, 'make sure Overwatch meets certain revenue goals, or 1,000 developers would lose their jobs'. Read more

item.title: Even as a massive Monster Hunter fan, I've never gelled with the spin-offs - but Monster Hunter Stories 3 has me hooked
item.description: I do love a bit of Monster Hunter; by which I mean a lot of Monster Hunter - I dread to imagine the total number of hours I've spent with the series over the years. item.title: Time to pay your last respects to Microsoft's "This is an Xbox" campaign, as it appears to have been killed off
item.description: This is an Xbox! Wait, is this an Xbox? Well, perhaps not anymore, as Microsoft appears to have quietly removed its marketing campaign which proclaimed the Xbox was less of a console and more of a platform that could be accessed on basically everything, even a toaster (ok, I am jesting a bit here for theatrical purposes, but just go with me on this). item.title: I sure hope the Resident Evil Requiem DLC is all about Grace, the best thing to happen to Resi in years
item.description: I adored Resident Evil 7. After the series' identity had slowly taken on water over the course of the last decade or so's mainline entries and spin-offs, Resident Evil 7: Biohazard (to use its full name) reminded us all why Capcom is the king of modern horror gaming. It managed to do two very important things: pay tribute to the origins of Resident Evil whilst also laying the foundations for what was to come over the next decade.
